seoTitle: Question Keyword Extractor: Pull Questions from a Keyword List
metaDescription: Filter a keyword list to question-style queries and group them by who, what, how, why, can and more. Good for FAQ and how-to content.
intro: Keeps keywords that start with a question word (or end with a question mark), and groups them by that word.
why:
Question keywords tell you what people want to know, and they fit FAQ sections, how-to guides and featured snippet answers. In a list of thousands they are hard to spot.

The filter looks for English question words at the start of a keyword, and optionally anywhere in it. It does not understand meaning: a keyword that starts with "can" or "is" may be a product name.
howTo: Decide whether to include keywords with question words later in the phrase.
Turn the best questions into headings with short direct answers.

faq.q: Which words count as question words?
faq.a: who, whom, whose, what, when, where, why, how, which, can, could, do, does, did, is, are, was, were, will, would, should, shall, may, might, has, have, am.
Unusual phrasing such as "best way to X" is not a question word start unless you tick the "anywhere" option.
Group them with the keyword clusterer or check intent with the intent classifier.
